about_the_game:
When a regular cat is dropped into a world of fantastical creatures and free-flowing magic, he must learn the arcane arts and become the ultimate wizard. To do that, he’ll have to fight his way through endless hordes of adorable enemies. Use portals to hop between vibrant  environments brimming with danger. Collect mystical runes and delve deeper into the arcane arts!

A Spell Array For Every Strategy

Craft spells by combining up to seven runes together for a near endless amount of spells. Hunt for synergies in Arcana and Power Shards which can be combined with spells to create big damage combos. Every rune is inscribed with their own unique meanings to create spells that are utterly unique. Like a real magic system, the spell engine interprets the player’s incantation on the fly and creates the in-game code to power the spell, meaning that even the creators of the game can’t predict what will happen.

If you’re the first to create a spell your name will be etched into the game’s magic system - so experiment! Anyone who comes across your spell afterward will see you were the first wizard to venture into those mystical arts.

New Spell Engine

The spell engine behind Wizard Cats mimics real magic. As a wizard you must wrestle the mystical arts to do your bidding. Use powerful runes to bend the world’s magic to your will, but be careful sometimes it doesn’t behave as expected. Only a true master of the arcane can adapt.

Hold It Against You

As players discover new spells so too does this unlock new spells for the world’s enemy wizards. Mobs have access to the player compendium, meaning a spell you use against them could come back around. Enemies learn quickly, so you’ll have to constantly adapt if you want to become the ultimate wizard!

short_description: The power of endless spellcraft is wielded by your paws in Wizard Cats, a roguelite embracing chaotic creation by letting you make any spell your heart desires. Craft spells that match your style, find synergies to become the ultimate wizard, and unleash your power on hordes of adorable creatures.
